verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a front-page status notice that high retrieval volumes repeatedly overload individual states and make them temporarily unavailable. That warns users about availability constraints up front, but it states no concrete operating window, per-day limit, or session timeout, and it concerns register retrieval rather than an online filing flow. missing for 10: published operating-hours window, stated per-day usage/retrieval limit, documented session timeout, coverage of the filing flow itself, independent corroboration.
